better-sg-reports.js.description: This script provides a comprehensive browser-based dashboard for analyzing SiteGround hosting metrics, including CPU, memory, and request data. It can generate detailed health reports, site overviews, and before/after change analyses with visual charts and export options, helping users track and demonstrate the impact of optimizations.
usage: Open the dashboard on a SiteGround hosting account page after capturing relevant data.
Run the script directly in the browser console or use as a bookmarklet to initialize the interface.
Ensure you have sufficient captured data; the dashboard waits for multiple API reports before enabling full features.
Interact with the tabs and controls to view specific metrics, generate reports, or export raw data and summaries.

ie-extractor.js.description: This script creates a floating image extractor panel on any page, which collects all images, detects if they are from iStock, and displays them in a sortable table. You can filter images by filename, alt text, or iStock ID, select images, and download their files directly. It enhances image management without altering page content permanently.
usage: Run the bookmarklet while on a page with images to activate the extractor panel.
Click the 🖼 Images FAB button to show/hide the panel.
Use the search box or filters to find specific images by filename, alt, or iStock ID.
Click download options in the panel to save selected images.
